methods.label: Compare the spacing of the points
methods.explanation:
Because the radii increase by equal amounts, compare how the circumference and area change at each step. For radius \(r\), the formulas are \(C=2\pi r\) and \(A=\pi r^2\). The circumferences are \(2\pi,4\pi,6\pi,8\pi,10\pi\), and the corresponding areas are
\[
\pi,\ 4\pi,\ 9\pi,\ 16\pi,\ 25\pi.
\]
Thus the horizontal gaps between consecutive points are all \(2\pi\), while the vertical increases are
\[
3\pi,\ 5\pi,\ 7\pi,\ 9\pi.
\]
The points must therefore rise from left to right with increasingly large vertical gaps. Choices B and C change direction, E decreases, and D has equal vertical gaps. Only choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\) shows the required pattern.
